name: 宝宝腰贴纸尿裤柔护款
description: 暖白软紫育婴房地垫系，讲透腰贴、弹力腰围与双层腿根的纸尿裤套图

styleLock.direction: soft nursery chalk-and-periwinkle ecommerce, quiet high-key care commerce for taped baby diapers
styleLock.backgroundSystem: a calm nursery floor: a chalk-white wall #F7F3EA meets a quilted play mat #EFEAE0 with visible stitched square channels and hairline seams #E2DACB, one low rounded periwinkle riser #AEB8E8 used instead of hard blocks, and rounded-corner copy cards #FFFFFF outlined in #AEB8E8; a single hairline seam rule #AEB8E8 marks section breaks; depth stays shallow and domestic; never an arch panel, never a stacked plinth, never a wave band, never an outdoor scene, no gradients outside the chalk field
styleLock.lightingSystem: diffuse frontal wrap light at about 5200K, near-shadowless and even across the whole set, one faint soft contact shade only at the line where the product touches the mat, no cast shadow, no rim flash, no directional drama, no dark falloff; the same 5200K logic holds inside the lifestyle frames so the set never splits into two lighting worlds
styleLock.surfaceSystem: quilted nursery mat #EFEAE0 with stitched channels in #E2DACB and a low periwinkle riser #AEB8E8 as the only stage element; matte card white #FFFFFF for copy fields; the product itself keeps its own finishes, the outer back sheet reading as a soft matte film with the faintest sheen and the inner touch surface reading as a cloth-like matte fibrous nap, the two never rendered alike and never as plastic gloss or as paper
styleLock.typography: one soft humanist Chinese sans display family for headlines plus one light geometric sans for body and labels; headline type in #4A4E7C on chalk white and chalk-white type on periwinkle; label type in #4A4E7C inside butter-yellow #F2D488 pill capsules; identical hierarchy, sizes and corner radii on every screen; all Chinese copy supplied as placeholders
styleLock.iconSystem: small butter-yellow #F2D488 pill capsules closed with a hairline #4A4E7C outline, each carrying one short dark label or one single-weight line pictogram; thin hairline circle markers in #AEB8E8 for sequences; hairline leader lines only; flat and quiet, one weight throughout; no aqua arches, no solid tiles, no filled colour icons, no 3D icons, no hazard stripes, no amber dots, no cartoon illustration
styleLock.presentationRules: the taped diaper is the only hero and keeps its identity on every screen: hourglass body, wide flat elastic waist belt, two side tape wings with a dotted fastening face, frilled dual leg cuffs, small printed repeat on the inner acquisition layer, proportions and colourway never re-tinted and never restyled; shown open, half-folded, rolled or in macro, always with a real contact shade on the mat and never floating; a single hairline keyline #F2D488 may trace the silhouette as a graphic device but never reads as a product part; the outer film side and the cloth-touch inner side are always rendered as two different materials; any baby is anonymous, back turned or cropped above the jaw, and always held by an adult, and no fastening action on a baby is ever shown
